name: Arcanic Systems Manual
summary: The Arcanic Systems Manual is a magical work sought for the Library in Ironforge. Adding it helps the library expand its knowledge.

sections.title: A Place in the Library
sections.body: The Library in Ironforge welcomes magical works that can benefit its collection. You bring one to add, and your contribution helps its knowledge grow.

faq.q: What is the Arcanic Systems Manual?
faq.answer: It is a magical work sought for the Library in Ironforge.
Someone at the Library in Ironforge asks you to bring magical works that may benefit its collection.

faq.q: Why bring the manual to the library?
faq.answer: The library's knowledge grows through contributions of magical works.
